method: per truth note: among the outputs with the same pitch starting within +/-150 ms, take the nearest; delta = out.start - truth.start. A constant must (1) come from a set the tool did not choose — it spoke about >= 0.9 of the notes on every sample — and (2) reproduce on a second sample of the same condition within 10 ms.

aubio.why: spoke about only 7 of 11 notes on sample A. The median is taken over the notes this engine chose to answer, so it describes the selection as much as the engine. Subtracting it would calibrate the ruler on the engine's own choice of which notes to report.

pyin.why: does not reproduce: 0 ms on sample A, -11 ms on sample C — a spread of 11 ms against a 10 ms bar. One sample cannot tell a fixed offset from this file's reading, and a second sample of the same condition disagrees, so there is no constant to subtract.
